description: Hosting and publishing service definitions: issued host suffixes, pricing, feed and publishing metadata

ads.description: true = provider injects ads or modifies served output on the issued hostname (forced banners/footers, JS injection); false = explicitly ad-free; absent = unknown

cloud.description: Cloud/CDN operator hosting the service site

costs.description: Pricing classification of the service itself

custom_domain.description: Users can attach their own domain (free or paid)

expire_days.description: Days without update/visit after which free sites are auto-deleted

feeds.description: Syndication feed formats emitted per site/blog; absent = none

hosted.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country where the provider's service site resolves

hosts.description: Domain suffixes under which user sites/blogs/apps are served

hosts_total.description: Real host count, only present in hosting.json when hosts was truncated

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the provider's legal seat

markdown.description: Content can be authored in Markdown

ns_suffixes.description: Operator name-server suffixes serving the issued hosts

own_domains.description: Deprecated alias of custom_domain on imported records

post_methods.description: How content is created: web = browser editor; api = programmatic API; email = post-by-email; git = git push (static generators); external-sync = authored in an external app/notebook that syncs; mobile-app = dedicated app; telegram-bot = via Telegram bot

public.description: Whether anyone can sign up and publish

record_types.description: DNS record types users can set (where the service also offers DNS control)

revalidation_days.description: Days after which users must manually revalidate to keep sites

status.description: active = signups and publishing work; restricted = issuance limited to certain users; no_new_registrations = existing sites live, no new signups; discontinued = service shut down

type.description: Service subtype: web = generic/shared web hosting; paas = deploy-your-code platform; pages = static site hosting; builder = WYSIWYG site builder; store = e-commerce/shop platform; app = SaaS product issuing user subdomains; devtool = online IDE/playground; tunnel = localhost tunnel/exposure; storage = object/CDN storage; forum = hosted forum/community; blog = classic blog platform; microblog = tumblelog/short-form; newsletter = email-first publishing; notes = single-page/anonymous publishing

until.description: Year the service ended (for discontinued providers)

updates.description: Whether hosted sites are static content or dynamic (server-side) apps
